newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian editor arrested, his magazine says.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian editor arrested, his magazine says.

text.p: The editor of an independent Nigerian magazine has been arrested by security agents, local newspapers reported on Saturday.
Godwin Agbroko, editor of The Week, was picked up from his office on Wednesday by three men who said they were security men, newspapers reported, quoting a statement by the magazine's management.
No reason had been given for the arrest, it said.
Journalists frequently have brushes with the authorities in Nigeria, a west African nation which has been in political turmoil since 1993 when the army scrapped an election to restore democracy.
